name: Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor
author: kishorrajpurohit

sections.description:
Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor is the most advanced and beginner-friendly testimonial slider widget for Elementor Page Builder. Showcase client reviews, star ratings, video testimonials, and Google reviews beautifully on any WordPress website.

Whether you are building a business website, portfolio, landing page, or agency site — this plugin helps you add powerful social proof that builds trust and increases conversions.

Simply drag and drop the widget inside Elementor, choose from 11 professionally designed layout templates, and customize everything visually — no coding required.

⭐ Why Choose Webdevez Testimonials Slider?

  • ✅ Works 100% inside Elementor — no shortcodes, no extra pages
  • ✅ 11 unique ready-made testimonial layout templates
  • ✅ Supports both Text AND Video testimonials
  • ✅ Google Review style templates included
  • ✅ JSON-LD Schema Markup for SEO rich snippets
  • ✅ Fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • ✅ Powered by Swiper.js — smooth touch & swipe support
  • ✅ Lightweight, fast, and clean code

🎨 11 Beautiful Layout Templates

Choose from 11 professionally designed testimonial layouts:

  1. Classic — Clean and minimal testimonial card
  2. Modern — Stylish card with bold typography
  3. Minimal — Ultra-clean simple testimonial layout
  4. Focused — Centered spotlight testimonial style
  5. Glassmorphic — Trendy glass-effect testimonial card
  6. Floating Avatar — Profile image floats above the card
  7. Left Accent — Colored left border accent style
  8. Gradient Accent — Beautiful gradient highlight card
  9. Glowing Glass — Glowing neon glass effect
  10. Google Review Card — Verified Google review style with badges
  11. Google Showcase — Google G logo with inline review display

🎥 Video Testimonials Support

Add powerful video testimonials directly inside Elementor:

  • YouTube video testimonials
  • Vimeo video testimonials
  • Self-hosted MP4 video testimonials
  • Aspect ratio controls for video containers
  • Clean video frame without Google branding overlap

🌟 Full Features List

Content Features:
* Text testimonials with name, designation, company, and photo
* Video testimonials (YouTube, Vimeo, MP4)
* Star ratings (1 to 5 stars)
* Company logo and company name display
* Quote icon with custom position (Top / Bottom)
* Custom navigation arrows using Elementor Icon Picker

Slider Controls:
* Autoplay with custom speed
* Loop / infinite scroll
* Touch & swipe support (Swiper.js)
* Slides per view (responsive controls)
* Space between slides control
* Transition effects: Slide, Fade, Coverflow, Flip
* Grab cursor option

Design & Styling:
* Advanced typography controls
* Custom colors for text, background, borders
* Card background and border radius
* Padding and margin controls
* Navigation and pagination styling
* Box shadow controls

SEO & Performance:
* JSON-LD Schema Markup for Reviews and Testimonials
* Generates SEO rich snippets in Google Search
* Lightweight assets — only loads on pages where widget is used
* Translation ready (i18n / l10n support)
* Clean, secure, and optimized PHP code

🔌 Elementor Integration

This plugin works exclusively with Elementor Page Builder. It adds a dedicated Testimonials Slider widget directly inside the Elementor panel under the General category.

No shortcodes. No Gutenberg blocks. Just pure Elementor drag-and-drop experience.

Compatible with:
* Elementor Free
* Elementor Pro
* All Elementor-compatible WordPress themes
* Hello Elementor, Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, and more

💼 Perfect For

  • Business & Corporate websites
  • Freelancer & Agency portfolios
  • E-commerce & WooCommerce stores
  • Landing pages & sales pages
  • Coaching & consulting websites
  • SaaS & digital product websites

🔒 Safe & Secure

  • Strict output escaping throughout
  • Follows WordPress coding standards
  • No external API calls
  • GDPR friendly
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Dashboard → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Make sure Elementor Page Builder is installed and active
  5. Open any page in Elementor Editor
  6. Search for “Webdevez Testimonials” in the widget panel
  7. Drag and drop the widget onto your page
  8. Add your testimonials and customize the design

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file
2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
4. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No. This plugin is an Elementor addon and requires Elementor Page Builder (free version is enough) to be installed and activated.

Is Elementor Pro required?

No. The plugin works perfectly with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required.

Does it support video testimonials?

Yes! You can add YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted MP4 video testimonials. Each testimonial item can be individually set as text or video type.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes. All 11 testimonial layout templates are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. You can also set different slides-per-view for each device size.

Can I show Google-style reviews?

Yes! Layout 10 and Layout 11 are specifically designed as Google Review templates with verified badges and Google G logo styling.

Does it support star ratings?

Yes. You can set star ratings from 1 to 5 for each testimonial item. Star color is fully customizable inside Elementor.

Does it help with SEO?

Yes! The plugin supports JSON-LD Schema Markup for Reviews and Testimonials, which helps Google display rich snippets in search results.

Can I add company logos?

Yes. Each testimonial item supports a Company Logo image and Company Name field.

How many testimonials can I add?

There is no hard limit. You can add as many testimonials as you need using the repeater field inside Elementor.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is fully translation ready with i18n/l10n support. You can translate it using Loco Translate or any standard WordPress translation plugin.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin assets (CSS and JS) are lightweight and load only on pages where the testimonial widget is placed.

Does it work with Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress themes?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with all major Elementor-compatible WordPress themes.

Is it compatible with WordPress 7.0?

Yes. The plugin has been tested and verified with WordPress 7.0.
